2239-5744-7507-8043.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast a spell for free using Vision this turn.
2239-5744-7507-8043.description:
Cast Kindred Charge for free due to Vision, choosing a creature type granted by Roshan, creating a token copy of each creature you control with haste, and setting up a delayed exile trigger.
Put the copy of Vision whose ability has been used in your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Ardent Elementalist token enters, it triggers, returning Kindred Charge from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

983-1432-2645-3430.easyPrerequisites: Ioreth of the Healing House doesn't have summoning sickness.
983-1432-2645-3430.notablePrerequisites: You control at least five lands.
983-1432-2645-3430.description:
Activate Temple of the False God by tapping it, adding six {C} due to Nyxbloom Ancient.
Activate Ioreth of the Healing House by tapping it, untapping Temple of the False God
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Ioreth of the Healing House.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.

4390-5078-6757-7633-8176.easyPrerequisites: You control two other untapped artifacts.
4390-5078-6757-7633-8176.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top from the battlefield onto the top of your library.
Activate Meria's second ability by tapping two artifacts, exiling Sensei's Divining Top with the ability to play it until end of turn.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from exile by paying {0} due to Geist of Saint Thalia.
Ravenous Robots triggers, creating a 1/1 Robot artifact creature token.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Weapons Manufacturing triggers, creating a Munitions token.
Repeat.

3764-6495-7924.description:
Activate Summoning Station by tapping it, creating a Clue token due to Flitwing.
Activate Evereth by sacrificing the Clue.
Summoning Station triggers, untapping it.
Resolve the Evereth ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Evereth
Repeat.
3764-6495-7924.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

728-3678-7084.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Retreat to Emeria triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Repeat.

2111-4981-6797.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Wingrattle Scarecrow
When Wingrattle Scarecrow dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Wingrattle Scarecrow enters, Serra Redeemer triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Wingrattle Scarecrow
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat.

5078-6089-7356.description:
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {0} due to Longshot.
Longshot triggers, dealing 2 damage to each opponent.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Skyswimmer Koi triggers.
Holding priority, activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Resolve the Skyswimmer Koi trigger, causing you to draw Sensei's Divining Top from your library, and then discard a card other than Sensei's Divining Top.
Repeat

1591-1778-2459-6516.easyPrerequisites:
It is an opponent's turn.
One of the {0}-cost creatures must be in your hand, with the other being on the battlefield.
1591-1778-2459-6516.description:
During an opponent's turn, cast the {0}-cost creature in your hand by paying {0}.
Glen Elendra Pranksters triggers, returning the other {0}-cost creature from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the spell from step 1.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any other creature you control

3259-4460-7752.easyPrerequisites: You've cast a noncreature spell this turn.
3259-4460-7752.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-4460-7752.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Council of Reeds triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.
3259-4460-7752.notes: If you start the combo with multiple Council of Reeds, you'll create a token for each of them. This'll result in you creating more tokens each loop for infinite tokens.

240-413-5470-7730.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
When the Egg enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
When the Egg enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 5, dealing 1 damage to any target
Repeat from step 3.

uses.n: Tetzin, Gnome Champion // The Golden-Gear Colossus

2388-5147-7124.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block and kill creatures you control.
2388-5147-7124.description:
Declare The Incredible Hulk and The Golden-Gear Colossus as attackers.
The Golden-Gear Colossus triggers, creating two creature tokens.
Holding priority, activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing a creature token, dealing 1 damage to The Incredible Hulk.
The Incredible Hulk triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it, then untapping it and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

uses.n: Heliod, the Radiant Dawn // Heliod, the Warped Eclipse

3532-4668-5078-6768.notablePrerequisites:
Uthros Research Craft has at least 12 charge counters on it.
Opponents have drawn at least one card this turn.
3532-4668-5078-6768.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Diving Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a charge counter from Uthros Research Craft.
Uthros Research Craft triggers, putting a charge counter on it and causing you to draw a card.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with three lore counters on it

112-698-1283-6577.notablePrerequisites: You've gained 3 or more life this turn.
112-698-1283-6577.description:
Activate Will by tapping it, causing white and blue spells you cast to cost {1} less for each life you've gained this turn.
At the beginning of your precombat main phase, Summon: Esper Valigarmanda triggers, putting a lore counter on it and triggering its fourth chapter ability.
Holding priority, cast Clockspinning with buyback by paying {1}, removing a lore counter from Summon: Esper Valigarmanda and returning Clockspinning to your hand.
Resolve the Summon: Esper Valigarmanda ability, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Cast Clockspinning with buyback by paying {1}, putting a lore counter on Summon: Esper Valigarmanda and returning Clockspinning to your hand.
Summon: Esper Valigarmanda's fourth chapter ability triggers.
Repeat from step 3.

4613-4968-6843-7267.description:
Activate Anti-Venom using Deathbringer Thoctar's ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, targeting itself and putting two +1/+1 counters on it due to its replacement effect and Michelangelo.
Activate Anti-Venom using Deathbringer Thoctar's ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.

3835-6867-6869.description:
Cast Appa by paying {2}{W}{W}.
When Appa enters, it triggers, airbending Aang.
Cast Aang from exile by paying {0}.
Appa triggers, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token.
When Aang enters, it triggers, airbending Appa.
Cast Appa from exile by paying {0}.
Repeat from step 2.

1170-1329-4708-4730.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, targeting Dark Sphere.
Cast Dark Sphere from your graveyard by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Sparring Mummy.
When Sparring Mummy enters, it triggers, untapping Emry.
Activate Dark Sphere by tapping and sacrificing it.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Grim Poppet and with toughness 2 or greater

1084-3108-4753.description:
Activate Grim Poppet by removing a -1/-1 counter from it, putting a -1/-1 counter on Clever Impersonator.
Flourishing Defenses triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Clever Impersonator by removing a -1/-1 counter from it, putting a -1/-1 counter on Grim Poppet.
Flourishing Defenses triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with exactly two lore counters on it

1883-2743-6669.easyPrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast Replication Technique
1883-2743-6669.description:
At the beginning of your precombat main phase. Summon: G.F. Cerberus triggers, putting a lore counter on it and triggering its third chapter ability, copying the next instant or sorcery spell you cast twice.
Cast Replication Technique by paying its mana cost, targeting Biovisionary.
Summon: G.F. Cerberus triggers, copying Replication Technique twice, with the copies targeting Biovisionary.
Resolve all Replication Techniques, copying Biovisionary three times.
At the beginning of your end step, each Biovisionary triggers. Resolve the first trigger, causing you to win the game.

225-5531-6620-6621.easyPrerequisites: Other lands you control can tap to produce at least {4}{C}.
225-5531-6620-6621.notablePrerequisites: Stone-Seeder Hierophant does not have summoning sickness.
225-5531-6620-6621.description:
Activate any number of other lands by tapping them, adding at least {4}{C}.
Activate Sylvan Safekeeper by sacrificing a land except Mirrorpool.
Repeat step 2 until you control no lands except Mirrorpool.
Activate Mirrorpool's third ability by paying {4}{C}, tapping and sacrificing it, creating a token copy of Lumra.
Put the Lumra token into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
The Lumra token's enters-the-battlefield ability triggers, causing you to mill four cards and return all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the lands enter the battlefield, Stone-Seeder Hierophant triggers that many times.
Resolve the first trigger, untapping Stone-Seeder Hierophant.
Holding priority, activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping a land.
Repeat from step 8 for the remaining triggers.
Repeat from step 1.
Resolve all Sylvan Safekeeper abilities

uses.n: Optimus Prime, Hero // Optimus Prime, Autobot Leader

2099-5263-6243.description:
Activate Sarcatog by sacrificing Optimus Prime, Hero.
When Optimus Prime, Hero dies, its second ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield as Optimus Prime, Autobot Leader.
Activate Sarcatog by sacrificing Optimus Prime, Autobot Leader.
When Optimus Prime, Autobot Leader dies, Valkyrie's Call triggers, returning Optimus Prime from your graveyard to the battlefield as Optimus Prime, Hero as an Angel with flying.
Resolve both Sarcatog abilities from steps 1 and 3.
Repeat.

1486-1753-5475-5929.notablePrerequisites: Leyline of Transformation on the battlefield with "Dwarf" chosen.
1486-1753-5475-5929.description:
Activate Forensic Researcher by tapping it, targeting Samut.
Magda triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Forensic Researcher ability, untapping Samut.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {W}.
Activate Samut by paying {W} and tapping it, targeting Forensic Researcher.
Magda triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Samut trigger, untapping Forensic Researcher.
Repeat.
1486-1753-5475-5929.notes: Once you have infinite Treasures, you may use them to activate Magda's ability.

1558-3529-3908-4231.notablePrerequisites:
Spark Double is a copy of Academy Manufactor.
Hoard Robber does not have summoning sickness and cannot be blocked by at least one opponent.
1558-3529-3908-4231.description:
Attack with Hoard Robber.
Hoard Robber triggers on combat damage to a player, creating three Treasure tokens, three Food tokens, and three Clue tokens.
Activate Time Sieve's ability by tapping Time Sieve and sacrificing five artifacts you control, taking an extra turn after this one.
Repeat.

2707-3357-5203.notablePrerequisites: An opponent controls at least one nonbasic land.
2707-3357-5203.description:
Activate Field of Ruin's second ability by paying {2}, tapping and sacrificing it, targeting any nonbasic land an opponent controls.
Holding priority, cast Radiant Performer by paying {3}{R}{R}.
When Radiant Performer enters the battlefield, it triggers, copying Field of Ruin's ability for each other nonbasic land your opponents control.
Resolve the first Field of Ruin ability, destroying the land it it targeting, then causing each player to search their library for a basic land card and put it onto the battlefield.
River Song triggers for each opponent who searches this way.
Resolve the first trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and dealing damage equal to its power to an opponent.
Repeat step 6 for each other trigger.
Repeat from step 4 for each other Field of Ruin ability.

405-2023-2232-2757.description:
Cast Resolute Reinforcements by paying {1}{W}.
Aragorn's first ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Human Soldier creature token.
When the Human Soldier enters the battlefield, Cloudstone Curio triggers, returning nothing to your hand from the battlefield.
When Resolute Reinforcements enters the battlefield, it and Cloudstone Curio trigger.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, choosing to return nothing to your hand from the battlefield.
Resolve the Resolute Reinforcements trigger, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters the battlefield, Cloudstone Curio triggers, returning Resolute Reinforcements to your hand from the battlefield.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping a Soldier token, untapping a basic Plains you control.
Activate the Plains by tapping it, adding {W}.
Repeat from step 8 for the remaining Soldier token.
Repeat.

3096-4059.description:
Cast Dance with Calamity by paying {7}{R}, exiling your library.
Activate Jace's first loyalty ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, causing target player to mill two cards and you to win the game due to drawing from an empty library.

765-1479-3678.notablePrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
765-1479-3678.description:
Play Guildless Commons.
When Guildless Commons enters the battlefield, it, Retreat to Emeria, and Kodama of the East Tree trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Guildless Commons trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Retreat to Emeria trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Guildless Commons from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Guildless Commons enters the battlefield, it and Retreat to Emeria trigger.
Repeat from step 4.
